modifications: no free 3D model was found with the parts this topic binds (separate atmosphere, clouds, glaciers, rivers, lake, aquifer): NASA 3D Resources, Smithsonian 3D, Poly Haven, Kenney/Quaternius, Wikimedia Commons searched 2026-10-16; marketplace models (RenderHub, CGTrader, Superhive) are not CC0/CC BY, Sketchfab downloads need a login; SRTM elevation tiles have no separate parts and the USGS download is login-gated

schematic Issyk-Kul basin generated by the pipeline script (deterministic noise, seed 23): snowy ranges with two cirque glaciers, meltwater rivers to a large mountain lake (level 0, depth to the lake bed shown in the section), grassland, steppe, spruce and leafy trees

clouds (valley cumulus with rain, grey cloud with snow over the glacier, a forming cloud over the lake), the Sun, and a sky backdrop as the atmosphere (64 px gradient texture, PNG → WebP via EXT_texture_webp)

decorative arrows: evaporation, transpiration, transport of vapour, infiltration; in the section view (client clips z > 0) flat arrows on the cut show infiltration to the aquifer and groundwater flow into the lake
ground block with strata; the aquifer (saturated layer, -0.8 … -0.5) is its own node on all block faces and in the section, with a pale water-table line
vertex colours (COLOR_0); gltf-transform: dedup, prune, weld, EXT_meshopt_compression + quantisation
